description:
Native runtime aborts decoding typed scalar values:
- vr2_float_arith (run): runtime/src/ir_runtime.rs:68 'fz_ref_load_float: invalid any value ref 0x...: UnknownTag(8)' — a value-ref word reaches the float loader with a tag it can't decode.
- vr5b_typed_print (run): same fz_ref_load_float UnknownTag panic.
- vr3_float_args (run): runtime/src/heap/imp.rs:66 'closure capture kind' — a closure capture carries an unexpected kind on a float-arg path.

All three are typed-scalar (float) lowering/runtime mismatches: the compiler hands the runtime a ref word whose tag/kind doesn't match the typed-scalar contract. Fix the float value-ref tagging + closure-capture kind on these paths so the typed loaders accept them. fz-vn5's original triage noted 'run/build legs panic in runtime float/closure paths' — this is that bucket.
title: [BUG] Runtime panics on typed scalar value paths (float load, closure capture kind)
